description: FNPF 3D lake with dry land of fnpf_3d_lake_dry_mpi2 (RK4, A 343 1, a third of the columns dry, 2 ranks) with A 321 0. fnpf_3d_lake_dry_mpi2 runs with the default A 321 2: the start values only in the wet columns, the kept coarse levels with the active columns of REEFMG, on 2 ranks. The case moves by 1e-4 between N 44 1e-8 and 1e-10, hence the tolerance.
covers: A 321 0 with dry columns on several ranks
A 321 2 against A 321 0 with dry columns
